lead.note: Beaver Creek Park (mt-19): Hill County camping page lists non-reservable campsites 'at Beaver Creek Lake' and group areas with 'Access to Beaver Creek'; entry is not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 48.308,-109.66: drive-in loops set back in open grass; Beaver Creek buried in a wide wooded/marshy corridor; bcpark.org lists 'access to creek' (walk-to) but no per-site map confirming creekside RV pads

lead.note: Chisholm (mt-20): FS says 'next to Hyalite Reservoir', East Fork Hyalite Creek along the north side; rec.gov lists Lake and Beach Access; entry is lakeview.
lead.prior_evidence: rec.gov 233741 'forest next to Hyalite Reservoir', no per-site shoreline flag; satellite: sites in forest set back ~40-75m from wide drawn-down East Fork inlet delta (main pool 300m+ NW); edge sites overlook open delta/reservoir but no open-apron pad within 50m of high-water shore

lead.note: Boulder Creek (mt-20): FS says 'The Wise River flows along the western border of this campground area'; entry is riverview.
lead.prior_evidence: semi-legible satellite: sites set among conifers ~35-45m from Boulder Creek behind a wooded riparian band, not an open bank; near sites overlook creek but no pads at waterline and no per-site map
